decisions.decision: Cascade-drop for verifier-dropped-sub semantics (over reparent-orphans or force-keep-sub-with-children)
decisions.rationale: If verifier judges a sub bogus, its leaves are probably suspect too. Simplest, safest, matches verifier's implicit 'this whole subtree is wrong' intent. Cascade drop marks leaves with _DROPPED_ATTR — existing insert loop + song_skills junction already honor that flag.
